scope: Independent read-only review of Astra userspace/classifier changes before root follow-ups
verdict: No integration blocker; no false PASS/BLOCKED or rejected valid lifecycle observed in reviewed tests
evidence_class: Host source inspection and synthetic software execution, not XNU/device runtime

host_engine_lifecycles: unmapped then mapped with historical totals
early release while backing remains quarantined

root_followups: derive checkpoint bits from observed classifier/child results
verify negative mappings publish no tickets
reject fully drained capability-backed retention without reported error
label device JSON as guest_self_report and host_verified=false
remaining_limits: Three-second post-exit polling window may yield a false FAILED on slow teardown.
SIGALRM may terminate without JSON; an outer runner must treat missing JSON as failure.
A release between the last live sample and child exit is outside sampled observation.
